bio: Dr. Dana Mohammad Khidhir is a petroleum engineer and academic researcher with a PhD in Petroleum Engineering. His research focuses on reservoir-fluid characterization, black-oil PVT analysis, crude-oil characterization, flow assurance, petroleum processing, process monitoring, and data-driven engineering.
His work also covers carbonate reservoirs, asphaltene and scale control, crude-oil desalting, produced-water treatment, carbon storage, and evidence-based scientific research workflows.
currentFocus: Reservoir-fluid characterization and black-oil PVT analysis

Petroleum processing, desalting performance and refinery process monitoring
Carbon capture and geological CO₂ storage in depleted and carbonate reservoirs
Data-driven engineering and evidence-based scientific research workflows
